displayName: Guardianship Supervision and Asset Oversight Advisor
description: 协助梳理监护监督安排，提供履职清单、财产监管要点与监督报告模板；不出具法律意见、不代理案件，需人工复核。适用需监护监督的家庭与个人。技术触发词「监护监督、履职记录、财产监管」。口语触发词「监护监督人的职责清单有哪些、履职记录怎么做才规范、监护中的财产监管要点有哪些」。输出可直接使用的清单、对照表与行动项。仅作规划与清单辅助，不构成法律/税务/医疗专业意见，需人工复核。 Helps families plan guardianship supervision with duty checklists, asset-oversight points and supervisor report templates. For families needing guardianship oversight. Covers: 监护监督, 履职记录, 财产监管. Use when the user asks to families plan guardianship supervision with duty. Helps families plan guardianship supervision with duty checklists, asset-oversight points and supervisor report templates. For families needing guardianship oversight. Output: structured checklist, comparison table, and prioritized action list. Planning aid only, not professional legal, tax, or medical advice; human review required. English edition and bundles: https://www.agensi.io/r/CREATOR8796142 (catalogue: https://github.com/Tingyun01/tingyun-skills).
